title: Densely Connected Convolutional Networks
blurb: Connects every layer in a block to all earlier layers by concatenation, so features are reused and each layer can be very narrow.
intro: A dense block keeps a growing stack of feature maps: each layer reads the whole stack and appends $k$ new channels. Bottleneck 1×1 convolutions keep the 3×3 layers cheap, and transition layers compress channels and halve the resolution between blocks. The steps cover the convolution, normalisation and pooling pieces; the capstone builds a DenseNet-BC from blocks and transitions.

steps.name: 1×1 bottlenecks and their savings
steps.note: Counting how cheap convolutions reduce cost, the motivation for the BC variant.
